original_test_intent: Measure four-point PCIe receive margins for every lane on all eight GPU links and screen signal-integrity quality while restoring ASPM and confirming no link/AER regression.
original_method: Map approved bridges/BDFs to physical links, snapshot link/ASPM/AER state, disable only L1/L0s on each target, run the exact AMDXIO parameters once per eight BDFs under watchdog, validate complete lane CSVs, restore ASPM and compare with the engineer-approved oracle.
manual_activity: PCIe SI/platform owner confirms eight bridge mappings, resolves acceptance direction/thresholds, authorizes ASPM changes and margining, and owns result/recovery.
required_inputs: Authoritative lane reference and resolved direction/zero rule
Approved ASPM baseline/restore and maintenance window
Link/AER limits, timeout/abort/OOB/recovery and evidence path
safety_requirements: Validate BDF-to-physical link immediately before writes
Snapshot ASPM/link/AER and change only approved targets
Run one link at a time unless concurrency approved
Abort on link loss, width/speed degradation, AER/DPC, hang or platform threshold
Always perform explicit ASPM restore/readback and post health; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Apply approved temporary ASPM changes and exact margin commands once
Validate eight-link lane-complete artifacts and restore state
Report raw margins/conflicts without inventing reference direction or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve acceptance contradiction and approve reference
Approve BDFs, tool, ASPM mutation and safety limits
Review every lane plus restoration and decide outcome

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic margin execution omits the source's discovery, eight-link scope, ASPM mutation, exact ranges and lane-level criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After topology/oracle approval, execute the eight exact AMDXIO four-point commands with state snapshots, independent watchdog and mandatory ASPM/link restoration verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All AMDXIO indices, BDF discovery, ASPM flags, BER/error/receiver and four range parameters plus eight-link scope are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed run manifest binding each physical link/BDF to pre/post state and its lane CSV, then evaluate left/right/top/bottom against the resolved oracle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds transactional ASPM restoration, complete topology/lane accounting and makes the acceptance contradiction explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No XGMI, single-link sample or PCIe bandwidth result substitutes for electrical margin coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Non-zero only proves the step search returned a margin; it may not prove compliance with a reference threshold.

project_override_considerations: SI engineering must decide whether reference comparison is minimum, maximum or another normalized rule and how the non-zero screen combines with it per lane/direction.
expected_evidence: AMDXIO hash/version/support approval and eight-link BDF map
Pre/post ASPM, speed/width, AER/DPC and topology snapshots
Eight link artifacts with expected lane counts and raw CSV hashes
Per-lane left/right UI and top/bottom mV versus resolved reference/zero rule
Restore readback, logs, recovery/dispositions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria simultaneously require values equal to or below reference and define PASS solely as all four values non-zero; direction and combination are not safely inferable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; the acceptance conflict and critical tool/state inputs can be queued for engineering while the library review continues.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row201 Wistron-AMD GPU-00194-V002: define whether each PCIe lane margin must be equal/below, equal/above, or otherwise compared with the reference, and how that rule combines with the all-four-non-zero screen; approve the eight current BDF/link/lane map, signed AMDXIO artifact, exact source parameters, ASPM disable/restore transaction, AER/link abort and OOB recovery contract.

review_improvement: Retains exact eight-link margin coverage and reversible ASPM control while exposing the contradictory lane acceptance instead of inventing a PASS rule.
independent_technical_reasoning: Margin values normally require direction-specific interpretation and a platform reference; merely being non-zero only shows some eye opening. The source's 'equal to or below reference' statement may describe step counts or an inverted screening convention, so reversing it by intuition would alter criteria. Because ASPM is modified per BDF, each result must remain transactionally bound to the discovered physical link and verified restoration.
